verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own transparency docs confirm Copilot has a memory feature that stores facts and uses past context/memory to personalize future responses and suggestions (copilot-docs-32, copilot-docs-33). However, this is explicit, user-requested memory rather than fully automatic recall of all prior conversation context, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming how reliably it works across chats. Missing for 10: independent verification of cross-session recall accuracy, detail on scope/limits of automatic context retention beyond explicitly stored facts.
